items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: I was telling Ralph I had this brother back home... And Ralph ended up putting all of this in an article

ctx.x: What finally got him out of Indianapolis, he came to California. Buddy and I were very stable in San Francisco by then. He came out and...let me get my things right...I think he brought his trio at one point and we set up a thing, a couple of gigs for him.

And we'd been going to Ralph Gleason, was talking to Ralph about it, and I was telling Ralph I had this brother back home and he was so-and-so. And Ralph ended up putting all of this in an article, which I was very pleased about because he finally heard Wes. Like everybody else he was flabbergasted.
Was this about the same time that Cannonball Adderley told Orrin Keepnews...?
